summary: Eldorado Gold filed a Form 6-K on October 9, 2026, attaching a news release announcing that the European Commission designated its Skouries copper-gold mine in northern Greece as a Strategic Project under the EU Critical Raw Materials Act. The release, quoting CEO Christian Milau, notes more than US$2 billion invested, approximately 20-year mine life, and hundreds of direct jobs. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or change of control is involved. This is a routine operational-regulatory announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
